metadata.name: Lark Build Relay controlled local KVPilot checks
metadata.description: Eight newly authored deterministic repository/workflow tasks sharing a compact synthetic context. These are controlled fixtures created for local development, not unseen production data or a validated external benchmark. No expected-answer list or question-specific hint is included in the shared context.
metadata.context_token_count_note: Measured with tokenizers.Tokenizer on the existing qwen3.5:4b tokenizer.json, add_special_tokens=False, without a model call. Complete prompts add instructions, question and chat-template tokens.
metadata.suggested_answer_instruction: Read the repository snapshot and answer the question using only its active files and rules. Return only the requested concise answer, with no explanation, label, quotation marks or Markdown.

steps: Collapse internal whitespace runs to one ASCII space
recommended_normalization.comparison: Case-sensitive exact equality of normalized complete response and expected_answer. Preserve punctuation, units, code fences and explanations as mismatches; truncated responses fail. No model judge or answer substring extraction.

limitations: All eight cases share one fictional repository and are correlated, so counts do not estimate general coding quality.
The task text and answers are available during development; this fixture is not a hidden holdout.
Exact-match formatting is part of the score. Preserve raw responses and paired changed-case IDs for interpretation.
Task quality must be checked on actual generation; fixture answers do not validate compression or caching on their own.

cases.question: What poll_interval_s is used by the current production worker? Output only the integer number of seconds.
What parallel_jobs limit does team mesa's current production worker use? Output only the integer limit.
What is the effective release ttl_hours for team orbit in production? Output only the integer number of hours.
Which delivery queue is used for repository ledger-ui? Output only the exact queue name.
Which artifact bucket stores releases from repository field-agent? Output only the exact bucket name.

A team mesa operation fails on every allowed attempt. Under its effective production retry settings, how many seconds are spent waiting between calls, excluding execution time? Output only the integer total.
What does delivery_state(priority=9, manual_hold=True, failed_checks=0) return? Output only the workflow state, without quotation marks.
What exact string does make_release_tag("  Beta_5  ", 12) return? Output only the tag, without quotation marks.
